claims.claim: Clean and powerful Trailer Head Engine
claims.evidence: Photos show visible grime and oil residue on the engine and wet/oily ground around it, inconsistent with 'clean'.

claims.claim: In excellent condition and ready for work
claims.evidence: No running footage, compression test, or start-up clip is shown; condition cannot be judged from static photos.
No performance or load test shown; power claims cannot be confirmed from photos.

risks.proof: Video of engine starting, idling, and revving, plus a compression test reading if possible
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-running/for parts or major rebuild needed

risks.risk: Unknown completeness of ancillary parts (turbo, injectors, sensors, wiring loom)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of turbo, injector pump, sensor harness, and wiring loom from multiple angles
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete, assuming missing key components

risks.risk: Internal wear state (pistons, bores, bearings) unknown
risks.proof: Oil sample/color photo, or video of exhaust smoke color on startup

risks.risk: Exact DAF engine model/displacement and year not identified
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine ID/serial plate with full model number
risks.if_unproven: Priced at lowest value for generic DAF truck engine of this valve-cover type

risks.risk: Possible accident, overheating, or flood damage history
risks.proof: Photos of engine block for cracks, corrosion lines, or water marks; coolant system close-up
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming possible hidden damage, worst case

risks.risk: No documentation or export/import paperwork confirmed
risks.proof: Photo/scan of ownership or import documents
risks.if_unproven: Priced as undocumented, higher resale risk

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running, including idle and throttle response
Close-up photo of the engine's ID/serial plate showing full model and displacement
Photos of turbo, injectors, sensors, and wiring loom completeness
Photo or video of oil condition and any exhaust smoke on startup
Any available ownership or import documentation
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a used DAF truck diesel engine, but grime visible in photos contradicts 'clean', and all performance/condition claims remain unverifiable from static images, so it must be priced at worst case pending running and completeness proof.
